purpose: Review every card whose stored alternative analysis competes with a fragmented or stroke-level learner decomposition. Retained cards use their small components productively; repaired cards group recognizable shapes or restore a concrete historical image.
candidate_rule: A card has stored historical components and either uses a low-level stroke component or has more current components than historical components.

候.equation: Visual comparison: 侯 marquis + 丨 line = 候 wait
候.mnemonic: The 侯 marquis stands behind a 丨 line and must 候 wait.
候.hero_image_prompt: A marquis waiting patiently behind a single queue line, no text or labels.
候.rationale: Groups the recognizable 侯 form and gives the one distinguishing line a direct job.

局.equation: Visual comparison: 尸 seated person + 句 sentence = 局 bureau
局.mnemonic: A 尸 seated person processes each official 句 sentence inside a 局 bureau.
局.hero_image_prompt: A seated clerk processing official papers inside a small bureau, no text or labels.
局.rationale: Replaces an abstract wrap stroke with the recognizable sentence-shaped lower form.

展.equation: Visual comparison: 尸 seated person + 衣 clothing = 展 unfold
展.mnemonic: A 尸 seated person spreads out 衣 clothing to 展 unfold it for display.
展.hero_image_prompt: A seated person spreading out a robe to unfold it for display, no text or labels.
展.rationale: Replaces five tiny inner fragments with the salient clothing-like form and a single action.

延.equation: Visual comparison: 廴 long stride + 正 straight = 延 prolong
延.mnemonic: Keep taking a 廴 long stride 正 straight ahead to 延 prolong the journey.
延.hero_image_prompt: A traveler taking long strides along a straight road that continues toward the horizon, no text or labels.
延.rationale: Uses the recognizable modern visual grouping while explicitly labeling it a comparison, not an exact stroke analysis.

然.equation: Historical image: ⺼ meat + 犬 dog + 灬 fire = 然 so
然.mnemonic: ⺼ meat from a 犬 dog burns over 灬 fire—the old image behind 然, which later came to mean “so.”
然.hero_image_prompt: An ancient cooking fire heating a small covered portion of meat, historical educational illustration, non-graphic, no text.
然.rationale: Restores the attested dog-meat-over-fire image instead of inventing roles for slash and ice fragments.

留.equation: 卯 dawn + 田 field = 留 stay
留.mnemonic: From 卯 dawn, workers remain in the 田 field and 留 stay through the day.
留.hero_image_prompt: Farm workers remaining in a field from dawn into daylight, no text or labels.
留.rationale: Restores the recorded 卯 plus 田 grouping and turns it into one compact temporal scene.

祭.equation: ⺼ meat + 又 hand + 示 altar = 祭 offer sacrifice
祭.mnemonic: A 又 hand places ⺼ meat on a 示 altar to 祭 offer sacrifice.
祭.hero_image_prompt: A hand respectfully placing a prepared meat offering on an ancestral altar, non-graphic, no text.
祭.rationale: Restores the attested hand-held meat offering instead of treating the meat form as slash plus ice.

第.equation: 竹 bamboo + 弟 younger brother = 第 ordinal prefix
第.mnemonic: A 竹 bamboo slip records a 弟 younger brother's 第 ordinal position.
第.hero_image_prompt: Younger brothers arranging bamboo slips into a carefully ordered row, no writing, text, or labels.
第.rationale: Uses the standard 竹 plus 弟 analysis and removes the unrelated mourning story.

舞.equation: Historical image: 無 dancer + 舛 crossed feet = 舞 dance
舞.mnemonic: 無 originally pictured a dancer; adding 舛 crossed feet made the motion explicit in 舞 dance.
舞.hero_image_prompt: An ancient dancer holding ornaments while the feet cross in a lively dance step, no text or labels.
舞.rationale: Restores the attested dancing figure and crossed-feet image instead of enumerating four stroke fragments.

那.equation: 哪 which − 口 mouth = 那 that
那.mnemonic: Remove the questioning 口 mouth from 哪 which, leaving 那 that.
那.hero_image_prompt: A questioning mouth disappearing as a hand points toward a distant object, no writing, text, or labels.
那.rationale: Uses an exact, familiar character subtraction instead of listing knife, two lines, and city.

電.equation: Historical image: 雨 rain + 申 lightning = 電 electricity
電.mnemonic: 申 originally pictured lightning; place it under 雨 rain to make 電 electricity.
電.hero_image_prompt: A bright branching lightning bolt flashing beneath a heavy rain cloud, no text or labels.
電.rationale: Restores the attested lightning-under-rain analysis instead of splitting 申 into sun and hook.
